main_results.result: Exact top/base/attempt critical control flow reproduced the default reload failure and same-instance repair.
The same A/B reproduced while reservation durability used the exact stable-sidecar writer implementation.

result: The previously static process-epoch blocker is now executable on the exact bytes of the three modules that create it. The exact top-level wrapper reloads the exact base module for each operation; the exact base module reloads the exact durable-attempt module for each operation; the exact durable-attempt module creates a new random _BOOT_SECRET at import. In the default RESERVE->SCORE path, the reservation is durably appended but the scorer is never called because the SCORE-side fresh attempt module rejects the permit MAC. When one exact attempt-module instance is injected across RESERVE and SCORE, exactly one scorer call succeeds. A second fresh module epoch rejects the old permit, and recovery reports fail_closed_unresolved_no_relaunch. Repeating the A/B with the exact stable-sidecar writer yields the same scientific result and creates the expected durable ledger/lock artifacts.
validated_contracts: Default-path failure occurs before scorer execution: scorer_calls=0, so this remains a liveness/integration defect rather than evidence inflation.
Within one process epoch, reusing the same exact attempt-module instance restores permit continuity and permits exactly one scorer call in the isolated critical path.
Across a fresh module/process epoch, the old permit is rejected and durable fail-closed recovery does not authorize stochastic relaunch.
The clean reservation append path remains compatible with StableSidecarJournalIO while preserving the A/B result.
measurement_validity_rules: Import-time secret/state identity is part of runtime equivalence when launch authority is authenticated by process-local state; blob equality alone is insufficient.
Validate both scorer-call count and exception class. A fail-closed result with zero scorer calls is not a successful evaluation lifecycle.
A valid repair must satisfy both within-epoch continuity and cross-epoch invalidation/no-relaunch.
Keep critical-path stub isolation explicit: stubs may remove unrelated semantics only; they cannot be used to claim full exact-sibling lifecycle validity.
scope_limitations: The critical A/B byte-executed exact top/base/attempt and, in the durable variant, exact stable-sidecar writer. Gate, score-wrapper and pipeline semantics were deterministic stubs chosen only to isolate module-instance identity.
